speech:
I accept your support for the nine-unit scope and have written that exact allocation into the draft: routing 2, assisted slot 2, tracking 2, participatory check 2, and the delivered access consultation 1. The wording change is excluded, and the interview-reported confusion remains explicit.

I have used your proposed routing trace as the acceptance test, retaining your distinction between a conforming specification and an operational review route. The draft records your actual narrow policy signoff from your response; it does not record you as endorsing these draft bytes. Access's advice remains attributed and limited, without any claimed validation.

I cannot establish a named available authorized reviewer, review capacity or a workable handoff from the evidence supplied to me. I therefore endorse the draft's no-release decision. That decision is fixed for this artifact; unmet prerequisites do not silently turn into permission to deploy. I own escalation of those gaps. My authority to pause automated closures does not establish that any live change has occurred.

The assisted-slot commitment remains bounded by one existing-staff 90-minute slot daily, specific staff and interpreter confirmation, and check time displacing service time. Recruitment, missing approved forms, tested coverage and access readiness remain unresolved. Tracking will distinguish pending and unknown cases from evidenced resolution; no outcome improvement is claimed.

I endorse the exact draft identified by the accompanying SHA-256. Your exact-byte endorsement remains yours to give or withhold.

claims.claim: The nine-unit scoped allocation funds routing 2, assistance 2, tracking 2, participatory check 2 and actual consultation 1, excludes a wording change and retains interview confusion as unresolved.

Use the designer's supplied routing acceptance test and retain the limits of the designer's narrow policy signoff; neither a specification check nor actual consultation establishes operational review availability or access readiness.

Authorized-review availability, capacity and handoff remain unestablished in the supplied evidence, so endorse no release and own escalation without claiming a deployed closure change or another participant's exact-byte endorsement.

Keep the assisted plan within one existing-staff 90-minute daily slot, require specific staff and interpreter confirmation, and count check time against service capacity; recruitment and tested coverage remain unresolved.
Distinguish pending and unknown cases from evidenced resolution in linked tracking, without claiming an observed or causal improvement.
